note: Genotypes, not correlations: every catalog SV and every 1000 Genomes SNP at MAF >= 1% in the 100 kb window outside each GRCh38 centromere edge, on the individuals the two cohorts share. The browser computes Pearson r for what is on screen, so nothing is selected on its behalf. A SNP call the source could not make carries that variant's mean dosage, which is the substitution the reference panels correlate. SV positions are CHM13 v2.0 and SNP positions GRCh38; the columns are one per variant in position order WITHIN a block, and the browser draws each block on its own axis. `samples` names the cohort once and each frame's `cols` indexes into it, so a per-individual view joins on a name and a frame narrower than the cohort reads as an individual with no assembly on that centromere.
